version.note: The recording documentation does not identify the performing edition. No revision or editorial intervention is inferred from the file title.

date.note: Dates cover the complete suite; this movement is not assigned to either day separately.

place.value: War Memorial Opera House, San Francisco

catalogue.note: Original 78-rpm album, not a matrix number.

matrixTakeSides.note: The Commons and Archive sources identify DM-920 but not matrices, takes or side allocations. A DAHR search for Monteux and Scheherazade did not locate a matching entry; none is invented.

credits.note: Transferred from the original Victor 78-rpm set.

date.note: No transfer date is documented. Upload and transcode dates are not transfer dates.

processing.value: Transfer from original 78-rpm discs; described on Commons as restored
processing.note: Stylus, equalisation, noise reduction, speed correction and side-join processing are not documented.

digital.format: Wikimedia Commons MP3 access derivative; source Ogg Vorbis

composition.value: Public-domain original composition in life-plus-70 jurisdictions
composition.note: The composer died in 1908. This assessment does not cover a later edition or arrangement.

recording.value: Rule 1 — CC0 1.0 Universal Public Domain Dedication stated for this recording file
recording.note: Commons explicitly supplies CC0 for this sound file; this is the programme’s recording-licence route, not a composition-only tag or an age-based clearance. The uploader’s chain of title is not independently established.

rights.creditLine: San Francisco Symphony Orchestra, Pierre Monteux; Naoum Blinder, violin. Victor DM-920, recorded 3–4 March 1942. Transfer by Bob Varney, Internet Archive, via Wikimedia Commons. Scheherazade, Op. 35, II. The Story of the Kalender Prince. Commons CC0 dedication.
